question: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.
evidence: full name refers to forename+surname; Youngest racer = MAX(dob)
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1, c2, c3 FROM (SELECT T1.forename AS c0, T1.surname AS c1, T1.nationality AS c2, T3.name AS c3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY JULIANDAY(T1.dob) DESC) AS __r FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, T3.name FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 on T2.raceId = T3.raceId ORDER BY JULIANDAY(T1.dob) DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: The youngest racer is the driver with the latest date of birth (MAX(dob)), and if several drivers share that date, all of them are returned. For each, give the full name (forename and surname), the nationality, and the name of the earliest race (by date) they took part in
b.sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, (SELECT r.name FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.raceId ASC LIMIT 1) AS earliest_race FROM drivers d WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)

c.request:
As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.
Evidence: full name refers to forename+surname; Youngest racer = MAX(dob)
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, r.name AS first_race FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN races r ON r.raceId = (SELECT res.raceId FROM results res JOIN races rr ON rr.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY rr.date ASC, rr.raceId ASC LIMIT 1) WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)

d.request: As of the present, what is the full name (forename and surname) of the youngest racer (the one with the latest date of birth), along with their nationality and the name of the race they first joined? If several racers tie for the latest date of birth, return all of them.
d.sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT r.name FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.round ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_race FROM drivers d WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
